description: Defines the PdfSignatureField class for handling digital signature fields in PDF documents within the PDFsharp library. Includes methods for rendering custom appearance, preparing for save, and writing dictionary elements, along with nested key definitions.

classes.name: PdfSignatureField
classes.description: Represents a digital signature field in a PDF document, providing rendering, preparation, and dictionary writing functionalities.

classes.name: PdfSignatureField.Keys
classes.description: Contains key definitions for the signature field dictionary, including required and optional entries like Filter, ByteRange, Contents, and metadata keys.

methods.name: RenderCustomAppearance
methods.description: Creates and sets the visual appearance of the digital signature in the PDF.

methods.name: PrepareForSave
methods.description: Prepares the signature field for saving, rendering custom appearance if needed.

methods.name: WriteDictionaryElement
methods.description: Writes a key/value pair into the signature field's dictionary, handling encryption considerations for the Contents key.
